gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-roboto: Stencil-cut and commanding, with lowercase that climbs high. Roboto follows in a friendly sans-serif with generous round mouths, so the loud heading gets a quiet, contemporary partner underneath.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-ruda: Wallpoet comes in bold, with gaps where the paper shows through. Ruda, a plain sans drawn like one pen tip, feels approachable and wiry beside it, a soft landing after the heading's commanding stencil cuts.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-saira: Commanding, Wallpoet stamps its tall lowercase down with paper-white breaks between letters. Saira follows in a clean sans, rounded letters stretching high and each s open, so the two feel like a loud voice and a steady one.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sofia-sans-semi-cond: Commanding in its looks, Unica One has a huge lowercase and curves you can see daylight through. And Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, a plain sans with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, shares that openness, which is the real link between them.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-savate: Goldman spreads its bold, commanding letters wide, with big lowercase and round forms like open parentheses. Savate, a sans with sturdy hairlines and a subtle weight shift along each curve, shares that openness, and that is what ties the two together.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Commanding from the first letter, Wallpoet has a smooth path around each bend and paper-white breaks. Schibsted Grotesk sits beneath in an approachable sans-serif, its tall-bowled e and a staying open, so the loud heading never crowds the text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-radio-canada-bi: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes with c tips that never close up. But Radio Canada Big does the quieter job, a monoline sans whose tall x-height fills the line and whose terminals finish clear of the stem.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-preahvihear: Autour One looks bent from a single length of tubing, expressive and bold, with clear channels into each round letter. Preahvihear, a plain sans with a lofty x-height and mouths open like a pried oyster shell, keeps a long page feeling light.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada is a plain sans with bulky lowercase and open c forms that never close into rings. Its text reads cleanly and steadily over a long stretch, while Flavors brings the whimsy up top.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Audiowide sets its futuristic glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, every stroke the same thickness with no thick-thin pulse. Noto Sans Elbasan, a plain sans, feels warmer and more open beside it.
